author: Xplode
title: Stream announcement preview
body: This sample post shows how a stream announcement could appear in the feed.

author: shinobi_preview
title: The moment Sekiro finally clicks
body: That first perfect deflect changes everything. Which encounter made the combat finally click for you?

comments.author: ashina_preview
comments.body: Genichiro taught me to stop dodging and trust my deflects.

comments.author: wolf_preview
comments.body: Lady Butterfly was the fight that finally made it click for me.

author: dropzone_preview
title: One squad. One circle. One chance.
body: You land with your squad and the final circle ends up on the other side of the map. What's your go-to strategy for getting everyone home?

comments.author: lastcircle_preview
comments.body: Grab a vehicle early and keep an eye on the next circle.

comments.author: squadmate_preview
comments.body: A chaotic squad road trip is half the fun.

author: horizon_preview
title: Pick one car for a sunset drive across Mexico
body: No races, no objectives: just your favourite car and an open road. What are you driving, and where's your first stop?

comments.author: roadtrip_preview
comments.body: Something classic, with the coast as the destination.

comments.author: aperture_preview
comments.body: I'd head for the volcano road and stop for photos on the way down.

author: tarnished_preview
title: Where would you return for the first time again?
body: The Lands Between are full of unforgettable discoveries. Which place or moment would you erase from memory just to experience it again?

comments.author: grace_preview
comments.body: Stepping into Limgrave for the first time, easily.

comments.author: rune_preview
comments.body: Taking the lift down to Siofra River was unforgettable.
